Component: Philips A51EAL155X Black Line FX colour picture tube

philips2000.Title: Philips Components product specification, 2000-01-21
philips2000.Hosting: Manufacturer document hosted by a third-party archive; printed page numbers.

usefulSize.Conditions: Nominal useful horizontal and vertical axes; outline approximated as a rectangle with user corner rounding.

stripePitch.Conditions: Approximate centre-to-centre spacing of IDENTICAL colour stripes at screen centre; treated as constant projected XY pitch across screen.

white.Conditions: White D used for luminance measurement, not an intrinsic fixed white of the tube.

glassTransmission.Conditions: Face glass at centre. Metadata only: reference luminance already includes glass; do not attenuate twice.

referenceLuminance.Conditions: Centre, focused raster, white x=0.313 y=0.329, current density 0.4 microampere/cm2. Not maximum luminance. Reference output mode divides this by user-supplied display white.

surfaceA.Conditions: Outer faceplate sag Z=A1*abs(X)^B1+A2*abs(Y)^B2+A3*abs(X)^B3*abs(Y)^B4; X,Y,Z in mm. Coefficient dimensions depend on exponents.

surfaceB.Conditions: B1,B2,B3,B4 in the outer surface equation; sagittal heights on page 11 use the diagonal endpoint as a different reference.

stripeFill.Conditions: Total emitting width per RGB period; three equal stripes, 25% black gaps. No measured slot aperture heights or stripe widths available.

decayRgb.Conditions: Only qualitative medium short persistence specified.
decayRgb.Fallback: Existing user Phosphor/DecayR/G/B/Persistence settings, explicitly effective estimates, never Philips measurements.

spot.Conditions: No calibrated current-dependent spot map used.
spot.Fallback: Existing user BeamMin/BeamMax/Focus settings; estimated Gaussian footprint.

scatter.Fallback: Existing Bloom/Halation artistic filters; physical stripe modulation is applied after glow and focus.

gunTransfer.Conditions: Gun graph not digitized or used; video amplifier/chassis not identified.
gunTransfer.Fallback: Existing artistic Gamma correction; not a calibrated gun or television transfer curve.

Assumptions: Observer on tube axis at ViewDistanceMm from centre apex; pinhole perspective, no glass refraction or thickness model.
Outer faceplate approximates emitting surface. Ideal corrected deflection maps raster uniformly in projected tube X/Y, not by ray from electron gun.
Surface equation is mirrored across both axes; inverse projection uses eight fixed-point iterations within useful area plus a small border.
Centre pitch extended uniformly; RGB order, fill and rectangular outline are approximations, not a measured slot-mask cell map.
Physical mask is evaluated at final geometry using pixel derivatives and a band-limited Fourier stripe filter; it does not enter persistence history or optical scattering.
Reference luminance mode is a relative scaling aid for a user-calibrated SDR display. Artistic effects and clipping prevent a guaranteed photometric match.
No television chassis, measured RGB decay constants, calibrated spot shape or optical scattering claimed.
